summary: Comprehensive end-to-end verification of Pagamenti<->Inquilini<->Proprieta connections after iteration 4 fixes. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (enriched tenants, properties with room counts, property detail with rooms+tenant_name, payments overview grouping, POST /payments happy path + 404 on invalid tenant). Frontend: all 6 tenants appear in payment dialog dropdown; Tenants table shows required columns (Nome, Immobile, Stanza, Deposito, Stato Mese) with 'Non assegnato' placeholder for unassigned; Properties page renders expandable cards with Stanze/Occupate/Libere stats and shows 'Nessuna stanza creata' when no rooms (current state: 0 rooms in DB). Sidebar navigation links all present. One minor UI polish issue noticed in the Payment dialog dropdown (see frontend_issues).

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown options panel is rendered BEHIND the Importo/Contanti/Data inputs below it (z-index/stacking issue). Options are still clickable but visually overlap form fields making it look broken. Use a higher z-index on SelectContent or portal to body above form rows.

action_items: (Optional polish) Increase z-index of Select dropdown content inside payment dialog so options do not appear behind subsequent form inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/properties.py GET /properties/{id}: still computes t['remaining_balance'] = total_due - total_paid on embedded tenants (lines 64-65). This reintroduces the legacy balance field that the iteration-4 refactor removed from the tenants endpoint. Should be deleted to stay consistent with the simplified payment model.

routes/payments.py and routes/properties.py duplicate the current-month range computation and the room->tenant payment aggregation (~30 lines). Extract into a shared utils module (was already flagged in iteration 4, still open).
routes/properties.py GET /properties has N+1 room query per property; fine for current scale but should aggregate if property count grows.
Frontend Payments.js: `allTenants = tenants` is a trivial alias; either remove or rename the prop for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 minor visual bug

seed_data_creation: No new seed. Used existing 6 tenants and 2 properties. One test payment (€1.00, TEST_connection_*) was inserted to verify POST /api/payments persistence - can be cleaned up via GET /api/payments and manual delete if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_connections.py -v. Current DB state: 2 properties (via cristoforis 15, via piovese 142), 0 rooms, 6 tenants (all unassigned). To fully validate the assigned->visible flow end-to-end, create a room via Stanze, assign a tenant via PUT /api/tenants/{id} with room_id, then: (a) GET /api/tenants should return non-empty property_address/room_number for that tenant, (b) GET /api/properties/{id} should list that room with tenant_name filled, (c) Properties page expansion should show the room+tenant. Payment dialog z-index bug is cosmetic only.
rca_of_the_issue: All connection bugs from the original problem statement are resolved. Payment dropdown fix (remove assigned-only filter) verified: 6 tenants listed including unassigned ones. Tenants-page enrichment (property_address, room_number, payment_status) verified via both API and UI. Properties detail endpoint returns rooms[] with tenant_name and count fields verified. Remaining property_detail embedded-tenant remaining_balance calculation (properties.py L64-65) is a legacy leftover to clean up but does not break any current UI.
